8232.title: Legacy WebView compatibility fallback
8232.rootCauseOneLine: The web build targets Chrome 111 while the native shell has no explicit compatibility failure path; the exact Chromium 92 black screen remains unverified.
8232.proposedFix: Capture the first failure on the actual engine, define the support policy, and add an actionable compatibility/readiness failure path.
8232.caveats: Same-agent clean-checkout repeat verified only build and shell-state findings. No Huawei device or Chromium 92 browser was available; no visual reproduction or PR.
